name: cx-goal-one-rule
task: Open the door and then pick up the box in the other room, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task's key clause is 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed'. Per the mapping, when the proposition's description already contains the condition ('key_lost: the matching key was acquired and then lost before the door was opened'), the ban is a soft Absence(key_lost), not a soft Precedence(door_open, key_lost). The Precedence clause instead only penalizes key_lost before door_open and lets a later key_lost pass unpenalized; replace it with a soft Absence(key_lost). The hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) plus hard Existence(target_picked_up) correctly capture 'open the door and then pick up the box' and together force door_open.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard captures 'open the door, then pick up the box' and forces door_open; the soft Absence(key_lost) correctly encodes the preference against losing the key while the door is closed, matching key_lost's definition ('lost before the door was opened').
